notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4a of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §2023:7.2.3.4 GR4: "If the SUPPRESS phrase is specified, library text incorporated as a result of COPY statement processing is not listed. If a listing is being produced, the COPY statement itself is listed." CopyProcessor.ParseCopyStatement keeps the phrase, the trace records it on the inclusion (ListingInclusion.Suppress), and the listing lists no line of the library text (nor of a COPY nested in it) while the COPY statement's own lines follow the LISTING state; the library text is incorporated in full either way. The earlier CONFORMS rested on the signed derivation DRV-GR-7.2.3.4-4 (unpopulatable-antecedent: no listing is produced, A.1 item 117); a listing is now produced on request (cobol --listing at 2002, 2014 and 2023), so the antecedent is populated and the derivation is withdrawn.
